title: Capitalization Bylaws, Article on Holdings — Number of Member Equities & Patronage Classes a Member May Carry
content:
A member of Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit may hold several Member Equities & Patronage classes at once — one borrower equity class, the two allocated surplus classes and preferred stock — so there is no overall cap on holdings. Which classes may be held together, and how many holdings of one class, is set by the bylaw provision on class combinations.

## The provision restated

| Kind of class | Classes | Held at the same time as the others |
|---|---|---|
| Borrower equity | One of the Class C Participation Certificate, Class A Nonvoting Common Stock or Class B Voting Stock | Yes |
| Allocated surplus | Qualified Allocated Surplus and Nonqualified Allocated Surplus | Yes |
| Preferred stock | Class H Preferred Stock | Yes |

No figure limits the total number of holdings a member carries across these classes.

## Hypothetical illustration

A farm operator who borrows, has received patronage in earlier years and has invested in preferred stock may carry four holdings at once: Class B Voting Stock, Qualified Allocated Surplus, Nonqualified Allocated Surplus and Class H Preferred Stock.
